title: Raku Pottery - Brooklyn and Staten Island (Raku Firing Day)
source_quote: SATURDAY November 7th - 11am - 5pm - Raku firing day STATEN ISLAND -This is the fun part! Join us in Maker Park in Staten Island for hours of glazing and firing your handbuilt pieces in our outdoor kiln!
